title: Junior backend engineer, Node.js/NestJS, remote SaaS
jd:
Junior Backend Engineer (Node.js / NestJS)
Tidepool HQ
Location: Remote, Southeast Asia time zones
Employment: Full-time

Tidepool HQ is a remote-first SaaS company that makes scheduling and booking software for clinics and salons. Businesses in five countries rely on our product to run their day, and our public API is used by many of their own integrations.

You will join our small backend team working on the public REST API and internal services. Day to day, you will build features in TypeScript with NestJS, design database tables in PostgreSQL, write automated tests with Jest, and review pull requests from teammates. We deploy several times a day through GitHub Actions.

We are looking for someone with about one year of experience (internships and part-time work count) building APIs with Node.js. You should be comfortable with TypeScript, SQL and Git, and you should write clear English, because most of our communication is async in chat and design docs.

It would be great if you have used Docker, worked with GraphQL, or set up background jobs with a queue such as BullMQ or RabbitMQ. AWS experience is a plus but not required.

We offer a home-office budget, flexible hours and an annual team meetup.

To apply, send a CV and a link to code you are proud of.

title: Junior data analyst, SQL/Power BI/Excel, government-adjacent agency
jd:
Data Analyst (Junior) – Community Enterprise Data Office (CEDO), Bangkok
Contract: 1 year, renewable. Fresh graduates welcome.
Salary: according to agency scale for bachelor's degree holders.
The Policy Insights unit tracks loan programs and training schemes for community enterprises in all 77 provinces. You will help turn program data into dashboards and short reports that directors use to decide where the budget goes.
You will write SQL queries to pull and clean data from our program database, build and maintain dashboards in Power BI, and prepare monthly summary tables in Excel for the finance unit.
You will also check data quality with field offices and explain trends in plain Thai and English to non-technical staff.
We are looking for a graduate in statistics, economics, computer science or a related field who is strong in SQL and Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP) and has built at least one dashboard in Power BI or Tableau.
Python with Pandas for data cleaning is a plus, as is basic statistics such as regression and hypothesis testing.
Experience with government or public-sector data, or with ArcGIS/QGIS maps, is an advantage.
Work is mostly office-based, with occasional trips to regional field offices.
Please attach a transcript and a sample of your dashboard or report work.
Applications close at the end of the month; shortlisted candidates will be invited to a short SQL exercise.
